title: Merge gate economics: cut the 42-minute full-suite gate without weakening it
summary: Explains why neither AGT-2839 review reuse (exact develop tip and delivery tree) nor the per-SHA verdict cache (new merge commit SHA, Windows-local) fired in the eight develop gates of 28/29 September 2026, and why test selection fell back to the full suite (no folder map; docs and multi-module spans force the fallback). Develop had moved 5 to 10 merges past each delivery's base. Recommends path-disjoint review reuse with a repo-contract slice, impact union from a generated project map, a daily develop full-suite guard that opens a cause card and suspends reuse when red, and per-branch gate slots with host capacity 2. Models 348 to about 201 gate minutes (-42%, range -37% to -46%) on the logged night, and cuts the work into six measured implementation cards.

implementationTasks.title: Gate economics metrics and Ops panel (baseline first)
implementationTasks.acceptanceScope: One read-only aggregation endpoint over develop gate receipts plus one cross-project panel and a per-project row in the existing pipeline-health block; no gate behaviour change.
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Gate economics metrics and Ops panel

Source of truth: `docs/merge-gate-economics/index.html` (AGT-2997). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Sections 04, 06 and Open decisions Q0 and Q7.

This card lands first. Every later gate card is judged against the baseline it produces. It must not change gate behaviour.

## Deliver

1. Receipt fields: extend `IntegrationGateReceipts.Record` so every `pre-develop-build-gate-N.log` also records the queue wait. This is `GateQueueWaitMs` plus the time spent waiting for the merge lock in `MergeIntoDevelopRunner`. Add a stable `gateRung=` token (`exact|disjoint|impact|full`; today only `exact` and `full` occur) after the existing header lines, without shifting the three-line durable-recovery header that `ReadExact` parses.
2. Aggregation endpoint: `GET /api/gate-economics?window=7d|30d` returns rows per project and one all-projects row. Each row has: gated merges, gate minutes per merge (median, p90, from `durationMs`), queue wait p90, reuse rate split exact/disjoint, full-suite share, the same-SHA retest rate from `GateResultCache.Report`, and the last nightly guard result once card 3 exists.
3. Frontend: a cross-project "Gate economics" block and a per-project row in the pipeline-health block. Use central design tokens and existing components. Include light and dark Playwright screenshots in the task `results/` folder.
4. Baseline: read the eight receipts of 28/29 September 2026 (merges `0e2b0f8d` to `2272ce8c`) on the Windows host. Record their verdict, durationMs and test-selection audit in the delivery report. This answers Q0: whether `full-suite=not-run; omitted=3` came from a red or out-of-budget backend step.

## Acceptance criteria

- Endpoint numbers equal a hand count over a fixture set of receipts, including legacy receipts without the new fields. Missing fields count as unknown, never as zero.
- The panel renders in both themes, and its aggregate row equals the sum of the visible project rows.
- The existing `IntegrationGateReceiptsTests` stay green, and a new test proves `ReadExact` still parses receipts carrying the new lines.

Out of scope: any change to reuse, selection or slots.

# Repo-contract test slice and gate-inert declaration

Source of truth: `docs/merge-gate-economics/index.html` (AGT-2997). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Section 04, rule R2, and Risks.

## Deliver

1. Tag every test that locates the real repository root with `[Trait("Category","RepoContract")]`. These are the tests using `RepoRoot(`, `FindRepoRoot(`, `LocateRepoRoot(`, `FindRepositoryRoot(` or `RepositoryRoot`: 33 files and about 359 test methods in `backend.Tests` at develop `742936e0`. Do the same in `runner.Tests` and `task-server.Tests` where applicable.
2. Add an architecture guard test that fails when a test class uses one of those helpers without the RepoContract trait.
3. Extend the `.agent-studio/project.yml` schema and `ProjectExecutionDefinition` with `gate.inertPaths` and `gate.globalInputs` lists. Set them for this repository:
   - inert: `docs/**` except `docs/app/**`, `.github/**`, `deploy/**`, root `*.md`;
   - global: `Directory.Build.*`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `global.json`, `NuGet.config`, `.nvmrc`, `.agent-studio/**`, `testsupport/**`, `tools/**`.
   Add a parser with validation errors surfaced as project definition issues.
4. Expose a verify command for the slice: `dotnet test backend.Tests/OrchestratorApi.Tests.csproj --no-build --filter "Category=RepoContract&Category!=MachineBound"`.
5. Document the lists and their upkeep owner in `docs/system/domains/pipeline.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- The guard test fails on a new untagged repo-root test and passes on develop after tagging.
- The slice runs in under 10% of the backend.Tests wall time on the same host. Report the measured numbers.
- Parser tests cover a missing section (defaults empty), invalid globs (definition issue) and the repository's own file.

Out of scope: using these lists in a gate decision (cards 4 and 5).

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Nightly develop full-suite guard

Source of truth: `docs/merge-gate-economics/index.html` (AGT-2997). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Section 04, rule R4; Risks; Open decisions Q4 and Q5. This card must be live before card 4 widens reuse.

## Deliver

1. Schedule: a backend hosted service with a configured daily time (default 07:00 Europe/Berlin) and an optional weekly Windows run (default Sunday 06:00). The daily run executes on the Linux runner host outside the Windows gate slot, on the exact fetched develop tip SHA. It runs the command set of `scripts/release/promotion-full-gate.sh`: every non-machine-bound .NET test in the solution, plus frontend lint, type-check, unit tests and build. Reuse existing execution and evidence primitives. Do not add a workflow engine.
2. Evidence: persist the run record (tip SHA, start and end, per-command results, and the last green SHA) in the project's pipeline evidence. Surface the result in the card 1 endpoint.
3. Red response: create exactly one cause card per failure fingerprint through the `FailureInterventionService` pattern (fingerprint dedupe ledger, Bug type, Preparation lane). The card lists:
   - the develop SHA range since the last green run;
   - the merges in that range, with those admitted through disjoint reuse listed first as suspects;
   - the failing test names.
   Set the project flag `disjointReuseSuspended=true`.
4. Green response: clear the suspension and record the SHA as the last green full run. It feeds the 24-hour reuse budget.
5. Skip the run when develop has not moved since the last green run. Record the skip.

## Acceptance criteria

- Tests cover: a red run creates one card, and a repeated identical red run creates none; a green run clears the suspension; an unchanged tip is skipped; a run on a moved tip tests the SHA fetched at start, not a later one.
- A dry-run mode prints the planned commands and the tip without executing.
- `docs/operations/develop-main-promotion.md` or the pipeline domain page describes the guard.

Out of scope: class-level coverage collection (Dossier B3, deferred).

implementationTasks.title: Disjoint-movement review reuse at the develop integration gate
implementationTasks.acceptanceScope: IntegrationGateReusePolicy gains the rung-2 disjoint decision with receipts, reuse budget and suspension; the gate runs compile plus the RepoContract slice on rung 2; existing exact-tip behaviour unchanged.
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Disjoint-movement review reuse

Source of truth: `docs/merge-gate-economics/index.html` (AGT-2997). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Section 04, rule R1, and Open decisions Q1 to Q3. Requires cards 2 and 3 to be merged.

## Deliver

1. Policy: extend `IntegrationGateReusePolicy.Decide` with a `Disjoint` state behind the existing project setting. Make it tri-state `off|exact|disjoint`; the default stays `exact` until the operator switches it. It keeps every existing AGT-2839 check except tip and tree equality, and adds:
   - (a) `base = merge-base(reviewed delivery, pre-merge tip)`, and every first-parent commit in `base..tip` has a green develop gate receipt;
   - (b) no gate-relevant file is shared between `base..delivery` and `base..tip` (inert paths from card 2 excluded);
   - (c) no global input changed on either side;
   - (d) the review's verify-plan digest equals the gate's full command-set digest;
   - (e) the reuse budget is not exhausted (6 consecutive disjoint reuses or 24 hours since the last green full run on develop), and `disjointReuseSuspended` is false.
2. Gate content on rung 2: compile plus the RepoContract slice, as a new level (for example `compile-and-contract`), in `PreDevelopBuildGate.LevelFor`.
3. Receipt: `reviewReuse=disjoint` with the base SHA, the develop range, the counts of checked paths, and the first failing condition when falling back.
4. Fix the stale class comment in `PreDevelopBuildGate` and the tree-SHA wording for the verdict cache in `docs/system/domains/pipeline.md`.
5. Replay harness: a test fixture repository reproducing the Dossier's eight merges from 28/29 September 2026. The rule must yield reuse for exactly `65b268d5`, `9154dbd1`, `c6673af8` and `ebbaef7d`.

## Acceptance criteria

- The policy table tests cover each condition failing alone, a shared inert file (reuse), a shared code file (no reuse), a global input (no reuse), budget exhaustion, suspension, and a conflict-resolved or replayed merge (no reuse).
- `exact` projects behave byte-identically to today.
- The card 1 panel shows the disjoint reuse share.

Target: reuse rate at least 40% and median gate minutes at most 25 for Agent Studio over 7 days, reported against the card 1 baseline.

# Impact union from a generated project map

Source of truth: `docs/merge-gate-economics/index.html` (AGT-2997). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Section 04, rule R3, and Alternatives axis B. Model-based selection stays rejected (AGT-W59 §5).

## Deliver

1. Map generation: derive `folderToTestProjects` at gate time from the `.csproj` `ProjectReference` graph (transitive: a source folder maps to every test project that reaches it) plus `frontend/` to `frontend-unit`. Record the map digest in the test-selection audit.
2. Inert rows: gate-inert paths from card 2 select nothing and do not count as a module.
3. Union: replace the "change spans modules" fallback in `DeterministicTestScope` with the union of mapped commands. Always add the RepoContract slice when a non-inert, non-code path changed.
4. Keep the full fallback for global inputs, unmapped paths, a stale map, and missing changed-file input.
5. Add `setup.Tests`, `operations-server.Tests`, `orchestrator-engine.Tests`, `retention.Tests` and `demo-replay-runner.Tests` to `.agent-studio/project.yml` as commands that run only when mapped.

## Acceptance criteria

- A `setup/`-only diff selects `setup.Tests` and the slice, not backend.Tests.
- A `runner/` diff selects backend.Tests, runner.Tests and task-server.Tests, not frontend-unit.
- A `global.json` diff runs the full suite.
- A new top-level source folder without a csproj is unmapped and runs the full suite.
- The pre-main gate still requires the full suite.
- Card 1 reports the full-suite share before and after.

implementationTasks.title: Per-branch gate slots with configurable host capacity
implementationTasks.acceptanceScope: Replace the singleton merge lock and the machine-wide gate lock with per-(project, integration branch) serialisation and a host-capacity counting semaphore (default 2); rollback and push semantics unchanged.
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Per-branch gate slots

Source of truth: `docs/merge-gate-economics/index.html` (AGT-2997). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Section 04, rule R5; Risks (CPU contention); Open decision Q6. AGT-W59 D2 keeps host scale-out measured. This card changes slot granularity on one host only.

## Deliver

1. `MergeIntoDevelopRunner`: replace `_mergeGate` (`SemaphoreSlim(1,1)`) with a keyed lock per (project, integration branch) that covers merge, gate and rollback. Keep `IsMergeGateBusy` semantics per key and one aggregate for the stable deploy drain. Push serialisation stays per branch.
2. `BuildTestGateRunner`: replace the process semaphore and the exclusive machine file lock with a counting semaphore sized by `Gates:HostCapacity` (default 2, allowed 1 to 4), implemented as numbered slot lock files so it holds across processes. Keep the queue-wait measurement.
3. `GateResultCache` project locks and the per-project dependency preparation must stay correct under two concurrent gates of different projects. Add a test proving no shared temp or cache path is written by both.
4. Setting surfaced in Project or Workspace settings, read-only in the first iteration, and in the card 1 panel.

## Acceptance criteria

- An integration test runs two projects' gates concurrently while two merges of the same project stay serialised.
- A rollback of one project's red gate does not touch the other branch.
- With capacity 1, behaviour is identical to today.
- A reversion rule is documented: return to 1 when p90 gate minutes rise by more than 25% against the card 1 baseline.
- Target: cross-project queue wait p90 at most 5 minutes.
